items.title: Install Echelon Foundry SDE 1.2.0
items.description: Adds .sde/ reference material and .echelon/sde.json via npx @echelon-foundry/sde init

items.title: Upgrade ROS installation from 1.2.1 to 3.0.3
items.description: Adopts the 3.x governance documents and the ros-fs launcher. The ten scaffold files that blocked the upgrade had no local edits (single commit each, the original 1.2.1 install), so the 3.x versions replace them without losing work. Also sets ros.json rosVersion to 3.0.3, which ros upgrade does not do itself.

items.title: Research Publisher vNext discovery and architecture analysis
items.description: Discovery against the real visual-engineering corpus (837 md, 756 published) and the current publisher engine. Produces deliverables A-O plus ADRs under docs/vnext/.

items.title: Re-run the vNext gap analysis against the requirements draft that landed mid-discovery
items.description: input-documents/research-publisher-vnext-requirements.txt (550b1b9) was committed after the discovery search ran. Deliverable E rewritten against it, its section 29 answered, deliverable O repositioned as a v0.2.0 revision.

items.title: Praxis gap G1: native releases >=3.3.0 ship no ros-fs assets, so the repo launcher 404s after upgrade; blocks moving past ROS 3.1.4 (see docs/echelon/foundations.md)
Praxis gap G2: praxis upgrade 3.5.0 seeds .echelon/toolchain.json with praxis 3.4.0 while recording 3.5.0
Praxis gap G4: ROS CLI older than installation plans a silent downgrade and doctor recommends it; add a downgrade guard
Limen gap G7: tool-owned limen-verify.yml runs unpinned npx verify --strict, breaking consumer CI on every release (doc 18 section 1 forbids floating versions)
Communication Engineering gap G8: 1.0.0 not on npm and installed commit not recorded in manifest
Folio gap G9 / Forma gap G10: no pinned published release (Folio) / 0.3.0 unpublished (Forma)
Tekmerion: ros.json rosVersion still 3.0.3 (legacy fallback, ignored by the 3.1.4 launcher); align only through a supported lifecycle path or owner decision
Tekmerion: adopt EchelonFoundry.Aegis.Core 1.0.0 at F# host boundaries (doc 18 section 2); planned with the GH-17 ingestion host
